area: Builders: whole-tenant export to Terraform (ZIA, ZPA, Cloud & Branch Connector, Client Connector)
title: Export from tenant as Terraform: every object in scope as workspaces for the official providers, adopted with import blocks or cloned with rules disabled, references by address, secrets as sensitive variables

checks.what: Each of the 101 object types is read through the installed SDK's own call from an offline fixture tenant and written as its provider resource with every argument the fixture holds, plus its import block
References between exported objects are Terraform addresses, unexported ones lookups by name, users ids only; every address used is declared
Secret canaries (pre-shared keys, passwords, passphrases, private keys, tokens, provisioning and API keys) never reach any file of the zip; secrets are sensitive map variables
Tenant strings with quotes, ${, %{ and line breaks stay plain HCL strings; comments stay one line
Out-of-scope reads (nothing ticked, or a type not ticked) are refused with 400 before any client is built; ZPA/Cloud & Branch/Client Connector need OneAPI
Clone mode writes no import blocks, every rule DISABLED and ZPA segments disabled unless asked; adopt mode keeps each object's state
Every generated .tf is terraform fmt-clean (terraform 1.9.8 locally; the test skips without terraform) and the zip holds only generated paths

findings.title: The secret-name mask also blanked switches and ratings whose names look secret (cookie_stealing_blocked, block_password_protected_archive_files, password_strength, cookies_and_proxy), which would have left them out of the export
findings.fix: the export's mask keeps true/false values and a short list of non-secret provider arguments; every other secret-named value is still masked

findings.title: zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 cannot read Cloud & Branch Connector account groups (its model names a class the SDK lacks, CommonIDNameExternalID), so the type is listed as not covered instead of failing the export
findings.fix: listed under not covered with the reason
